meta.title: Vitor Mendes — Aerial straps artist and performer
meta.description: Aerial straps and extreme flexibility. Physical theatre, character creation and artistic make-up. Available for seasons, festivals and events.
meta.ogAlt: Vitor Mendes hanging from aerial straps in a full split, red theatre curtain behind him.

media.alt: Vitor Mendes hanging from aerial straps in a wide open split, arms extended, red theatre curtain behind him.
media.posterAlt: Opening frame: a body held in a split in mid-air, dark stage.

01.alt: Vitor Mendes as a serpent in a yellow and black snakeskin suit and scaled crown, crouched on a white rope net with one arm extended.

02.alt: Profile portrait of the serpent: mint-green scaled hood, green brows, white face and dark green mouth.

03.alt: The serpent in a full green costume, arms open and head lifted, against a deep teal curtain.

04.alt: The serpent crouched face-on in the ring, legs wide and hands on the floor, green light behind.

05.alt: The serpent in a deep backbend, head upside down between the arms, hands open toward the audience.

01.alt: Close-up of Vitor Mendes in the dressing room: white base, green scales painted at the temple, green brow and glittered green mouth.

02.alt: Face-on shot of the finished serpent make-up: white mask, drawn green brows, lime-green lips and scales along the side of the head.

03.alt: Finished make-up in daylight: gold-yellow scales running down the side of the face, eyes lined in black, green ombré mouth.
